subject: c-fo-act
title: C.FO.ACT.------DYM.F.
description: Diagram in PCC-25, paired with v1-p341-1. (C)C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism) is crossed with DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). The main line bends at (R)INT (the reality of intention): C-FO-ACT → (R)INT → DYM-F (the crossing). PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) branches from the C-FO-ACT → INT stretch, and PR-TRS branches from PHY-U-P. VT-U-PT (vibrational universe particulars) branches from the INT → DYM-F stretch; C-CONT (composite continuance), EXT-DYM (extended dynamics) and TR (transformation) branch from VT-U-PT, and (R)INFO-DE (the reality of information degrees) and MT-INFO (multi-information) branch from TR.
